title: Local diamond for two exceptional rational-component contractions
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-field, def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $(P,M)$ be a semistable multipointed $k$-curve [def-trf-multipointed-curve, def-trf-multipointed-curve-modification], and let $r:P\to C$ be a morphism to a $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that the image under $r$ of every connected component [def-weil-connected-scheme] of $P$ contains more than one point. Call an irreducible component $A\simeq\mathbf P^1_k$ [def-sc-p1-standard] exceptional when $r(A)$ is a singleton and $A$ contains at most two distinct points of $M\cup P_{\mathrm{sing}}$, where $P_{\mathrm{sing}}$ is the nonsmooth locus. An elementary contraction of $A$ is a scheme pushout [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of $P\leftarrow A\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] whose quotient pair $(P_A,M_A)$ is semistable, whose marking map $M\to M_A$ is an isomorphism, and through which $r$ factors. For every supplied elementary contraction $h_A:P\to P_A$, its curve map is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and surjective with connected geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre], is an isomorphism $P\setminus A\simeq P_A\setminus\{h_A(A)\}$, and its induced reference map $r_A:P_A\to C$ again has image containing more than one point on every connected component. If $A\ne B$ are exceptional components and elementary contractions $h_A:P\to P_A$ and $h_B:P\to P_B$ are supplied, then $h_A|_B$ and $h_B|_A$ identify $B$ and $A$ with exceptional irreducible components $B_A\subset P_A$ and $A_B\subset P_B$ for the induced reference maps. There exist elementary contractions $j_A:(P_A,M_A)\to(T,N)$ of $B_A$ and $j_B:(P_B,M_B)\to(T,N)$ of $A_B$ to the same semistable multipointed curve, with compatible reference map to $C$, such that $j_Ah_A=j_Bh_B$ as morphisms of pointed $k$-curves. No connectedness, separatedness or properness of the structural maps to $k$ is assumed.
